title: 第二百一十章 大夫来管打井的事第二百零九章 你还是个小厨娘呀
content_zh:
第二百一十章大夫来管打井的事？
王大壮和孙菲菲带着采药的队伍下山的时候，太阳已经偏西了，金色的余晖铺在石板路上，把每个人的影子都拉得很长。
背篓里的药材随着步伐轻轻晃动着，发出干草和泥土混合的细微摩擦声。
只不过，当一帮人刚到村口，就听到了一阵争吵声——
不是那种邻居拌嘴的动静，是带着火气的、互不相让的嗓门，还夹杂着铁锹和锄头磕在地上的叮当声。
王大壮跟孙菲菲对视一眼，充满不解道：“发生啥事儿了？”
几个村民看到王大壮像是看到救星一样喊道：“王医生，你快去看看，李翠兰家挖井跟师傅吵起来了，那些人要加钱！”
众人听后，王大壮立即把背篓放在路边，孙菲菲也跟着一起赶了过去。
李翠兰家院子外面围了一圈人，里面站着一个穿迷彩服的男人，四十来岁，皮肤黝黑粗糙，手里拿着一把铁锹，脸上的表情像是被人欠了钱。
旁边还站着两个年轻小伙，一个手里拎着锤子，一个扛着钢钎，看起来是他的徒弟。
“说好的八百，你现在要一千二？你这不是欺负人吗？”李翠兰的声音又急又气。
“你家这井不好挖，比预想的深了两米，石头也多，费工费时，八百块钱根本打不住。不加钱，这活没法干了。”一个粗嗓门的男人回了一句。
“你开挖之前来看过的，当时你说八百包干，现在井都打好了，你跟我说要加钱？哪有这样的道理？”李翠兰站在对面，一手叉腰，脸上又气又急。
“八百包干是包干，可你家这井底下全是石头，比预想的难挖多了。我们多干了活，多出了力，加钱天经地义。”迷彩服男人把铁锹往地上一插，“要不你就再加四百，要不这活我就不干了，井口我给你填上。”
“你——”李翠兰气得话都说不利索了，“你这不是欺负人吗？”
围观的人有人皱眉，有人小声嘀咕，但没有人上去插嘴。
这种事，外人插不上话，尤其是这种外村来的打井师傅，更是得罪不起。
王大壮拨开人群走了进去，站在李翠兰身边：“这位师傅，我是村里的医生。你们这井都打好了，八百块钱的活干完了才说要加钱，这不是临时加价吗？你一开始来看过场地，预算也是你自己报的，现在活干完了要加钱，说句不好听的，这不就是欺负人家一个女人家好说话？”
迷彩服男人的脸色变了，上下打量了王大壮一眼：“你谁啊？大夫来管打井的事？”
“大夫管不了打井的事，但管得了讲理的事。”王大壮却是据理力争到：“你要觉得八百亏了，当初就别报这个价。现在活干完了才说加钱，理亏的是你。”

迷彩服男人的脸色彻底沉了下来，手里的铁锹往地上一顿，凶神恶煞道：“你少在这里跟我扯什么理不理的！老子干了活，就得拿对应的钱！少一分都不行！”
他偏头朝身后的两个徒弟使了个眼色，“你们几个愣着干什么？干活！”
两个年轻小伙提着锤子就往前走，其中一个还抬手指着王大壮的鼻子警告道：“你少管闲事！再啰嗦老子连你一起收拾！”
第二百一十章大夫来管打井的事？
对方的手还没碰到王大壮，王大壮已经抓住了他的手腕。
速度很快，快到周围的人都没看清是怎么发生的。

Chapter 210: Will the doctor take care of the well digging?
When Wang Dazhuang and Sun Feifei led the herb collection team down the mountain, the sun was already setting in the west, and the golden afterglow spread on the stone road, making everyone's shadow long.
The medicinal materials in the backpack swayed gently with the steps, making a subtle friction sound of hay and soil.
However, when a group of people arrived at the entrance of the village, they heard a quarrel——
It wasn't the kind of noise where neighbors were quarreling, it was the angry, unwilling voices, mixed with the sound of shovels and hoes hitting the ground.
Wang Dazhuang and Sun Feifei looked at each other and asked with confusion, "What happened?"
When several villagers saw Wang Dazhuang, they shouted as if they were seeing a savior: "Doctor Wang, go and have a look. Li Cuilan's family is quarreling with the master about digging a well. Those people want more money!"
After everyone heard this, Wang Dazhuang immediately put the backpack on the roadside, and Sun Feifei followed him.
A circle of people gathered outside Li Cuilan's yard. Inside stood a man in camouflage uniform. He was about forty years old, with dark and rough skin. He was holding a shovel in his hand and had an expression on his face as if he was owed money.
There were two young guys standing next to him. One was holding a hammer and the other was carrying a steel drill. They seemed to be his apprentices.
"We agreed to eight hundred, but now you want one thousand and two? Aren't you bullying others?" Li Cuilan's voice was urgent and angry.
"Your well is difficult to dig. It's two meters deeper than expected, and there are too many rocks. It's labor-intensive and time-consuming. You can't dig it with eight hundred yuan. Without more money, this job won't be possible." A man with a rough voice replied.
"You came here before the excavation. At that time, you said that the well would be paid for 800 yuan. Now that the well is drilled, you tell me that you need to pay more? How can this make sense?" Li Cuilan stood opposite, with one hand on her hip and her face angry and anxious.
"Eight hundred is a lump sum, but the bottom of your well is full of rocks, and it's much harder to dig than expected. We have done more work and put in more effort, so it is only natural to add more money." The man in camouflage uniform thrust the shovel into the ground, "How about you add another four hundred, or I will stop doing this work, and I will fill in the mouth of the well for you."
"You -" Li Cuilan was so angry that she couldn't speak clearly, "Aren't you bullying others?"
Some of the onlookers frowned, some murmured, but no one stepped forward to interrupt.
Outsiders can't get in on this kind of thing, especially a well-digger from another village, who can't afford to offend him.
Wang Dazhuang walked through the crowd and walked in, standing next to Li Cuilan: "Master, I am the doctor in the village. Your well has been drilled, but after the work of 800 yuan is completed, you are asked to pay more. Isn't this a temporary increase? You visited the site at the beginning, and you reported the budget yourself. Now you have to pay more after the work is done. To put it bluntly, isn't this bullying a woman who is easy to talk to?"
The face of the man in camouflage clothes changed, and he looked Wang Dazhuang up and down: "Who are you? Is the doctor in charge of digging wells?"
"The doctor can't control the matter of digging a well, but he can control the matter of reasonableness." Wang Dazhuang argued with reason: "If you feel that you are at a loss of 800, don't quote this price in the first place. Now that you are asking for more money after the work is done, you are the one who is responsible for the loss."
The face of the man in camouflage clothing completely darkened, he slammed the shovel in his hand on the ground, and said fiercely: "Don't talk nonsense to me here! I have to get the corresponding money after I have done the work! Not even a cent less!"
He tilted his head and winked at the two apprentices behind him, "What are you guys doing in a daze? Work!"
The two young men walked forward with hammers in hand. One of them raised his finger and pointed at Wang Dazhuang's nose and warned: "Don't mind your own business! If you keep nagging me, I'll take care of you too!"
Chapter 210: Will the doctor take care of the well digging?
Before the opponent's hand touched Wang Dazhuang, Wang Dazhuang had already grabbed his wrist.
The speed was so fast that no one around could see what was happening.
